title: Bridge Street bakery, after the refit
variant: A plan to scale on a half-meter grid, with the queue and the fire run drawn on
prompt: Draw the bakery's new layout to scale from the measurements I took, and mark the two things I am worried about: the queue at the door and the way to the fire exit.
note: The plan shape. One meter is eighty board units and the grid is half a meter, so a reader who drags a table has moved it by a distance the plan can name, and the corner note says so. Walls are square boxes with a heavy stroke, openings are a short line in the background color over the wall, and rooms are frames so the kitchen exports on its own. The two worries are marker: the queue is a freehand stroke in from the door, the fire run is a dashed line from table six to the exit, and each has a note with a measurement and an arrow bound to what it measures. Measurements are the prompt's; furniture is at catalog size; the queue count is from three mornings at the door.
